observations: Opened assets/panels/02-4.png: Ananya sits at left, turned toward Meera, who stands at right. Both smile at each other. Identity matches main-cast.png: Ananya has the bun, stud, stethoscope and white coat over teal; Meera has the braid, blue kurta and bangle.

Hands checked. Ananya's right hand (image left of her torso) is raised in a small fist at her chest. Her left hand rests on the desk beside the laptop. Meera holds the phone at hip level in her right hand (image left, bangle visible), with a calendar icon on the screen. Her left hand hangs at her side at the bottom edge of the frame. This matches production.hands and staff-phone heldBy meera.right.
The laptop screen faces the reader and shows blank bars and a button, nothing readable. The scene text says 'screen not visible', so the record does not match the art.
Office decor differs from 02-1 and 02-2: a blue curtain, a framed leaf print and a doorway to a reception area are new, and the window treatment changes. I treat this as minor drift.

The top-left of the raw art (about 0-480 x 0-210) is a hard-edged untextured white rectangle. In page-02.png no lettering covers it, because the balloon was placed at x=400. It is visible as a blank block above the bookshelf, with a straight edge against the painted wall.
The balloon 'One team. Better coordination.' sits between the two figures. Its tail ends at Ananya's mouth side and does not cover either face or Meera's phone.
